bundles.descriptionZh: 对照同一项目的两版申报材料，标出改了哪里、哪些数字和依据变了。
bundles.descriptionEn: Compare two versions of an application and show what changed in the text, figures, and supporting evidence.
examplesZh: 旧稿和改好的那版都发你了，帮我看看这次到底改了哪些地方。
帮我对一下两版里的营收和研发费，看看改过的数有没有换成对应的附件。
老板让我交最终版，你帮我看看这版跟上周那份比，有没有把关键的专利或政策依据删掉。
examplesEn: I've sent you the old and revised drafts. Can you show me what actually changed?
Compare the revenue and R&D spending in both versions and see whether the supporting attachments were updated for the changed figures.
My boss wants the final version. Compared with last week's draft, did we drop any key patents or policy references?

bundles.descriptionZh: 把一套申报材料里的数字、名称和说法互相核对，指出对不上的地方。
bundles.descriptionEn: Cross-check the figures, names, and statements across an application and flag inconsistencies.
examplesZh: 申请书前面写三条产线，后面变成了四条，帮我看看还有没有这种对不上的地方。
公司改过名，帮我把申请书和附件过一遍，看看哪里还写着旧名字。
申报书里的研发起止时间，和后面附的立项书、验收报告对得上吗？
examplesEn: The application says three production lines up front and four later. Can you find any other inconsistencies like that?
We changed our company name. Can you check the application and attachments for places that still use the old one?
Do the R&D dates in the application match the project approvals and acceptance reports attached at the back?

bundles.descriptionZh: 把企业的产品、研发、资质和知识产权资料整理成能用于申报的底稿。
bundles.descriptionEn: Organize a company's product, R&D, qualification, and IP records into a fact sheet for applications.
examplesZh: 客户把营业执照、产品册和一堆证书都发来了，先帮我整理一份申报用的企业资料清单。
这些文件里分得清公司做哪些产品、现在有效的资质有哪些吗？帮我汇在一张表上。
第一次给这家工厂做申报，现有资料我都放这儿了，帮我看看还得找企业要哪些基本材料。
examplesEn: The client sent a business license, product brochures, and a stack of certificates. Can you organize them into a checklist for applications?
Can you tell from these files what the company makes and which credentials are still valid? Put it all in one table for me.
This is our first application for this factory. All the records we have are here. What basic documents do we still need to ask for?

bundles.descriptionZh: 把申报材料里的数字和关键说法逐项对到原件、页码和计算过程。
bundles.descriptionEn: Link the figures and key claims in an application to their source documents, page numbers, and calculations.
examplesZh: 报告里写了市场占有率 18%，帮我把这个数的出处和算法找出来，评审问起来能翻到原件。
材料说我们给三家头部客户供货，帮我看看各自能拿哪份合同或发票来证明。
这份申报书里数字太多了，能不能做张表，让我一眼看出每个数字出自哪个文件的哪页？
examplesEn: The report says our market share is 18%. Find the source and calculation so I can pull up the original if reviewers ask.
The application says we supply three major customers. Which contract or invoice can we use to back up each relationship?
There are so many figures in this application. Can you make a table that shows the file and page each figure came from?

bundles.descriptionZh: 根据财务原件复算营收、研发费和增长率等指标，核对报表和申报表里的数字。
bundles.descriptionEn: Recalculate revenue, R&D costs, growth rates, and other figures from financial records and check them against the application.
examplesZh: 审计报告和申报表上的营收差了一截，帮我找找申报表上的数是从哪儿来的。
这三年的研发费用和销售收入都在附件里，帮我重算一遍研发费占比。
我填的营收增长率是 12%，麻烦按财务表验一遍，顺便把怎么算的留给我。
examplesEn: Revenue in the audit report is quite different from the application. Can you trace where the application figure came from?
The attachments have three years of R&D costs and sales revenue. Can you recalculate the R&D spending ratio?
I entered revenue growth of 12%. Please check it against the financial statements and show me how you calculated it.

bundles.descriptionZh: 把读起来生硬或像套话的中文改得顺口，保留事实、术语和引用。
bundles.descriptionEn: Make stiff or formulaic Chinese writing sound natural while preserving facts, terminology, and citations.
examplesZh: 这公司简介开头就说赋能、引领，读起来太空了，帮我改成我们平时介绍业务的说法。
我把公众号初稿发你，帮我把句子写顺一点，里面的数字和引文照原样留着。
这段申报材料写得太像模板了，帮我改得自然些，改完我想直接贴回申请书。
examplesEn: This profile opens with talk of empowering and leading. It feels empty. Can you rewrite it the way we actually introduce our business?
I'll send you the first draft for our WeChat account. Smooth out the writing and leave the numbers and quotes as they are.
This application paragraph sounds like a template. Make it read more naturally so I can paste it back into the form.

bundles.displayName: 高新技术企业申报体检
bundles.descriptionZh: 免费版高企申报体检：依据国科发火〔2016〕32号与195号逐项核验八大硬门槛、双年度成长性与四列缺口清单，严认原件不估分。
bundles.descriptionEn: Use R&D, IP, and financial records to assess high-tech enterprise eligibility and compare application years.
examplesZh: 我们今年能报高企吗，帮我看看条件够不够。
今年报还是明年报更稳？我们只有两件软著，还有一件专利今年没下来。
财务表和专利清单我发你，帮我核对一下高企硬门槛和双年度缺口，列一份四列补强清单。
examplesEn: Can we apply for high-tech enterprise status this year? Please check if we meet the requirements.
Is it safer to apply this year or next? We only have two software copyrights and one patent still hasn't been granted this year.
I'll send you the financial statements and patent list. Check our High-Tech eligibility gates and list four-column remediation gaps.

bundles.descriptionZh: 按给定目录查产品落在哪条产业链、哪个环节或哪类产业基础。
bundles.descriptionEn: Use the supplied catalogs to find the industry chain, link, or industrial foundation category a product belongs to.
examplesZh: 按我发的产业链目录找一下，我们做伺服电机的归在哪一条、哪一环？
这款工业相机在《产业基础创新发展目录》里有对应条目吗？该往“工业六基”哪一类找？
我们的齿轮箱是给农机用的，目录里该看农机那一条，还是看基础零部件？
examplesEn: Can you use the industry chain catalog I sent to find the right chain and link for our servo motors?
Is there an entry for this industrial camera in the Catalog for Industrial Foundation Innovation and Development? Which of the six industrial foundation categories should I check?
Our gearboxes go into farm machinery. In the catalog, should we look under farm machinery or basic components?

bundles.descriptionZh: 核对专利、商标和软著的权利人、状态及产品归属，挑出能用于申报的证据。
bundles.descriptionEn: Check ownership, status, and product links for patents, trademarks, and software copyrights, and identify usable application evidence.
examplesZh: 这几件专利有两件是后来转过来的，帮我查查权利人现在是不是我们公司。
有件专利可能忘了交年费，我把编号发你，帮我看看现在还有效吗？
专利、商标和软著清单我发你，能用来报项目的帮我挑出来，顺手标下各对应哪个产品。
examplesEn: Two of these patents were transferred to us later. Can you check whether our company is now listed as the owner?
We may have missed a patent renewal fee. I'll send the number. Can you check if it's still in force?
I'll send our patent, trademark, and software copyright list. Pick the ones we can use in applications and mark which products they relate to.

bundles.descriptionZh: 找齐项目适用的管理办法、工作指引和原版附件，查清该按哪版条件和表格办。
bundles.descriptionEn: Find the program rules, guidance, and original attachments and identify which requirements and forms apply.
examplesZh: 今年浙江专精特新看哪个管理办法？把现行文件和原版评分表一起发我。
我们下载了两份高企申报附件，版号不一样，这次该填哪份？
听说研发费的算法调了，麻烦帮我找找正式文件里这条到底怎么写。
examplesEn: Which rules apply to Zhejiang's specialized SME program this year? Send me the current rules and original scoring sheet.
We downloaded two high-tech application attachments with different version numbers. Which one should we fill in this time?
I heard the R&D cost calculation changed. Can you find exactly what the official document says?

bundles.descriptionZh: 把查政策、收材料、撰写和复核排成申报计划，方便团队按分工推进。
bundles.descriptionEn: Turn policy research, document collection, drafting, and review into a plan the application team can follow.
examplesZh: 下周五要交专精特新申请，财务、研发和行政各自先做什么？
老板让我们同时报高企和省级研发中心，帮我排个时间表，哪些材料能共用也一起标出来。
客户资料才收了一半，帮我排一下从补资料到交表的顺序，最后谁负责检查也写上。
examplesEn: Our specialized SME application is due next Friday. What should finance, R&D, and admin each do first?
My boss wants us to apply for high-tech status and a provincial R&D center at the same time. Build a schedule and mark the documents we can reuse.
We've collected only half the client's documents. Put the remaining steps through submission in order and show who should do the final check.

bundles.descriptionZh: 按企业所在地区、产品、研发和投资计划筛选可报项目，排出先后顺序。
bundles.descriptionEn: Find suitable government programs based on a company's location, products, R&D, and investment plans, then rank them.
examplesZh: 我们在余杭做精密零件，今年有两条产线要改，有哪些项目可以报？
高企刚过，手里还有几件授权专利，接下来有什么项目值得提前准备？
人手只够做两个申报，按我们今年的研发投入和投资计划，帮我挑一下先做哪两个。
examplesEn: We make precision parts in Yuhang and are upgrading two production lines this year. Which programs could we apply for?
We just got high-tech enterprise status and have a few granted patents. What programs are worth preparing for next?
We only have enough staff for two applications. Based on this year's R&D spending and investment plans, which two should we do first?

bundles.descriptionZh: 汇总客户项目的进度、已确认决定和缺件，方便下次继续或交给同事。
bundles.descriptionEn: Summarize a client's project status, decisions, and outstanding documents so you or a colleague can pick it up later.
examplesZh: 小李下周接手这家客户，把现在报到哪一步、谁手里还有什么资料整理给她。
接着上次那个技改项目，上回客户确认了哪版投资清单，还有哪几张发票没收？
这是刚开的客户会纪要，帮我把定下来的事和下次该找谁补资料更新到交接稿里。
examplesEn: Li is taking over this client next week. Can you put together a handoff showing where the application stands and who has which documents?
Let's pick up the equipment upgrade project. Which investment list did the client approve last time, and which invoices are still missing?
Here are the latest client meeting notes. Update the handoff with what we decided and who to chase for the remaining documents.

bundles.descriptionZh: 免费版专精特新与小巨人申报体检：依据工信部企业〔2026〕2号核验硬门槛、研发强度、主营占比、资产负债率与申请书基础矛盾，输出四列缺口清单，严认原件不估分。
bundles.descriptionEn: Check eligibility and estimate the score for specialized SME or Little Giant recognition, then prioritize the gaps to address.
examplesZh: 我们想报浙江专精特新，去年营收不高，先帮我看看能不能报。
我们准备冲小巨人，目前只有两件发明专利，哪些条件要先补？
按我发的财务、研发和专利数据，帮我核一下专精特新硬门槛差距和平台评价待补事项。
examplesEn: We want to apply for specialized SME recognition in Zhejiang. Last year's revenue was low. Can you check if we qualify?
We're aiming for Little Giant recognition and only have two invention patents. Which requirements should we work on first?
Check our Specialized SME hard-gate gaps and platform evaluation evidence using our financial, R&D, and patent data.

bundles.descriptionZh: 找申报案例、往期公示名单和填报模板，核对它们的出处和批次。
bundles.descriptionEn: Find application examples, past public lists, and templates, and verify their sources and rounds.
examplesZh: 帮我找一下杭州上一批高企认定的名单，顺便查我们公司有没有上榜。
去年省级企业研究院公布的名单在哪儿？帮我把原文件和附件都找出来。
手头有上一批技改项目的公示案例吗？我想看看别人报的是哪条产线。
examplesEn: Find the list from the last high-tech enterprise recognition round in Hangzhou and check whether our company made it.
Where's last year's published list of provincial enterprise research institutes? Can you find the original notice and attachment?
Do we have any published examples from the last technical upgrade round? I'd like to see what production lines other companies applied with.

bundles.descriptionZh: 从官方公示和企业公开资料里找同产品、同项目的获评同行，方便对标。
bundles.descriptionEn: Find comparable companies recognized under the same program using official lists and public company information.
examplesZh: 去官方公示里找几家跟我们一样做工业视觉检测、已经认定小巨人的公司。
我们做农机传动件，浙江有没有同类企业过了专精特新？帮我核下它们具体做什么产品。
从这批公示里挑三家跟我们产品接近的，看看它们公开写了哪些技术和专利。
examplesEn: Find a few officially recognized Little Giant companies that make industrial visual inspection systems like ours.
We make farm machinery transmission parts. Have similar companies in Zhejiang received specialized SME recognition? Check which products they actually make.
Pick three companies from this published list with products close to ours and see what technology and patents they publicly describe.

bundles.descriptionZh: 用企业已有资料写申报书里的企业简介、主导产品和核心技术等段落。
bundles.descriptionEn: Draft application sections on the company, its main products, and its core technology from existing business records.
examplesZh: 这份公司介绍是给客户看的，帮我改成申报书里能用的企业简介。
产品手册和检测报告都在这儿，帮我写一段主导产品介绍，把它用在哪、好在哪里说清楚。
这套设备把换线时间从半小时缩到了十分钟，技术说明和试用记录都发你了，帮我写一段申报书里的核心技术和实际效果。
examplesEn: This company profile was written for customers. Can you turn it into an introduction for the application?
Here's the product manual and test report. Write a main product description that explains what it's used for and what it does well.
This equipment cut changeover time from half an hour to ten minutes. I sent the specs and trial records. Can you write a paragraph on the core technology and results for the application?

bundles.descriptionZh: 核对中国专利申请 Word 稿里的权利要求、说明书和附图，给出能定位到原文的修改意见。
bundles.descriptionEn: Review a Chinese patent application in Word and give actionable comments on the claims, specification, and drawings.
examplesZh: 这份发明专利稿明天要发给代理人，帮我看看权利要求有没有哪句在说明书里找不到支撑。
图纸上这个零件标的是 12，正文有几处写成 21，帮我找全了标在 Word 里。
我把专利申请的 Word 稿发你，摘要和图上的术语帮我对一遍，有问题直接加批注。
examplesEn: I'm sending this invention application to our patent agent tomorrow. Can you flag any claims that the specification doesn't support?
This part is labeled 12 in the drawing, but some places in the text say 21. Find them all and mark them in Word.
I'll send you the patent application in Word. Please check that the abstract and drawings use the same terms and add comments where needed.

bundles.descriptionZh: 从设备联网、系统使用和生产成效看工厂做到哪一步、离数字化项目申报还差什么。
bundles.descriptionEn: Assess how far a factory has digitized and what it still needs for an application, using equipment connectivity, system use, and production results.
examplesZh: 车间一半设备上了网，系统也能查工单，我们报数字化车间还差哪些东西？
厂里刚上 MES，想往智能工厂做，现在就该开始留哪些运行记录？
准备报未来工厂，帮我看看设备、仓库和生产系统这几块的数据现在有没有串起来。
examplesEn: Half the equipment is connected and we can look up work orders. What are we still missing for a digital workshop application?
We've just put in an MES and want to work toward smart factory recognition. What operating records should we start keeping now?
We're preparing a future factory application. Can you check whether data from our machines, warehouse, and production system is connected?

bundles.descriptionZh: 用公开资料摸清合作企业的股东、业务和经营风险，整理成合作前简报或报告。
bundles.descriptionEn: Use public records to summarize a prospective partner's ownership, business, and operating risks before you work together.
examplesZh: 有家自动化公司想给我们供设备，全称发你了，帮我先看看它和实际控制人都是什么背景。
对方想做我们的独家代理，签约前帮我查查它的股东、对外投资和公开诉讼记录。
明天去见这家客户，帮我从公开资料做份会前简报，重点讲它做什么、最近在扩什么业务。
examplesEn: An automation company wants to supply us with equipment. I've sent its full name. Can you check the company and who controls it?
They want to be our exclusive distributor. Before we sign, check their shareholders, investments, and public litigation records.
I'm meeting this customer tomorrow. Put together a briefing from public sources on what they do and where they're expanding.

bundles.descriptionZh: 把项目、产品、专利和材料之间的关系画出来，方便顺着图找到关联文件。
bundles.descriptionEn: Map the links among projects, products, patents, and documents so you can find related files from the graph.
examplesZh: 把这个申报文件夹里的研发项目、专利和产品连成一张图，我开会要拿给老板看。
审材料时老找不到一件专利对应哪个项目，能不能做张图，让我顺着关系找到相关文件？
刚补了几份研发记录，帮我更新原来的关系图，看看哪些项目还连不上产品。
examplesEn: Turn the R&D projects, patents, and products in this application folder into a diagram I can show my boss at the meeting.
When reviewing the application, I keep losing track of which project a patent belongs to. Can you make a map that leads me to the related files?
We've added some R&D records. Update the existing map and check which projects still can't be linked to a product.

bundles.descriptionZh: 核对绿色工厂申报要填的能耗、用水和环保数据，找出自评缺项和对应材料。
bundles.descriptionEn: Check energy, water, and environmental data for a green factory application and identify gaps in the self-assessment and its evidence.
examplesZh: 厂里电和水都有计量表，做省级绿色工厂自评还得补哪些数据？
这份绿色工厂自评表填好了，帮我看看污水和能耗这两项算得对不对。
我们准备报绿色工厂，能耗和产量数据我发你，先看看哪几项最拉分。
examplesEn: We meter both electricity and water. What other data do we need for a provincial green factory self-assessment?
We've filled in the green factory self-assessment. Can you check the calculations for wastewater and energy use?
We're preparing a green factory application. I'll send you our energy and output figures. Which items are hurting our score most?

bundles.displayName: 高新技术企业申请书撰写
bundles.descriptionZh: 按高企申请书模板填写或核对研发项目、高新产品和其他申报栏目。
bundles.descriptionEn: Fill in or review the R&D, high-tech product, and other sections of a high-tech enterprise application form.
examplesZh: 这六个研发项目先帮我填进高企表的 RD 栏，名称和起止时间照我发的清单。
高企申请书里两个产品的 PS 表帮我补一下，销售收入用我发的这张表。
高企申请书 Word 发你了，帮我核一下里头的研发项目和高新产品能不能对上。
examplesEn: Please enter these six projects in the RD section of the high-tech application, using the names and dates in my list.
Can you fill in the PS forms for the two products in our high-tech application? Use the sales figures from this spreadsheet.
I've sent the high-tech application in Word. Can you check that the R&D projects tie back to the high-tech products?

bundles.descriptionZh: 看新设备、新材料和新软件适合报首台套、首批次、首版次还是工业新产品。
bundles.descriptionEn: Find the best recognition route for new equipment, materials, or software across first-set, first-batch, first-version, and new industrial product programs.
examplesZh: 我们做了套新的视觉检测设备，已经有一家客户在用了，能申首台套吗？
我们做的是质检软件，首版次和工业新产品该选哪个？
这款新材料去年就开始卖了，现在还有机会报首批次吗？
examplesEn: We built a new visual inspection system and one customer is already using it. Can it qualify for first-set equipment recognition?
We make quality inspection software. Should we apply for first-version software or new industrial product recognition?
We started selling this new material last year. Is there still a chance to apply for first-batch recognition?

bundles.descriptionZh: 用产品收入、客户应用和专利等资料，判断主导产品在产业链中的位置和申报写法。
bundles.descriptionEn: Use sales, customer applications, and patents to identify where the main product sits in the industry chain and how to explain it in an application.
examplesZh: 报小巨人得写主导产品，我们三款产品都有收入，结合客户和专利帮我看看选哪款。
我们的伺服驱动器装在数控机床上，申报书里怎么讲清它在产业链里解决了什么问题？
以前客户都买进口接头，现在有两家换成我们的了，报项目要写国产替代的话，还得拿什么证明？
examplesEn: We need to name our main product for the Little Giant application. All three have sales. Which should we pick given the customers and patents?
Our servo drives go into CNC machine tools. How do we explain in the application what problem they solve in the industry chain?
Customers used to buy imported fittings, and two have switched to ours. What evidence do we need to make the import substitution claim in our application?

bundles.descriptionZh: 把设备合同、发票、付款和入账资料对起来，算清技改补助能计入多少投资。
bundles.descriptionEn: Match equipment contracts, invoices, payments, and asset records to calculate eligible investment for a technical upgrade subsidy.
examplesZh: 这条新产线买了三台设备，合同和发票都给你了，帮我算算能报多少技改投资。
这台设备是备案前买的、备案后才付款，申报补助的时候这笔钱能算进去吗？
有几张设备发票跟付款对不上，帮我逐台查一遍，看哪些设备还缺单据。
examplesEn: We bought three machines for this new line. I've sent the contracts and invoices. How much investment can we claim for the upgrade?
We bought this machine before filing the project and paid for it afterward. Can this cost count toward the subsidy?
Some equipment invoices don't match the payments. Check machine by machine and tell me which ones are missing paperwork.

bundles.descriptionZh: 从制造企业的财务、税务和交易资料中找出现金流卡点和账税需要核对的地方。
bundles.descriptionEn: Use a manufacturer's financial, tax, and transaction records to identify cash flow problems and issues to reconcile.
examplesZh: 利润有几百万，账上现金反而越来越少，帮我看看钱主要压在哪里了。
我们有几笔发货、开票和到账跨了月，帮我按账和单据捋一下，哪些要跟会计对一对。
年底想做次财税体检，三张财务报表和纳税资料都给你，哪些地方最该先查？
examplesEn: We're making millions in profit, but cash keeps going down. Can you find where most of the money is tied up?
A few sales were shipped, invoiced, and paid in different months. Can you go through the records and flag what I need to check with accounting?
We want a year-end financial and tax check. I'll give you all three financial statements and the tax records. What should we look at first?

bundles.descriptionZh: 查找与产品技术相关的专利，帮企业安排查新、申请优先级和上市前的专利排查。
bundles.descriptionEn: Search for patents relevant to a product and help prioritize novelty searches, filings, and pre-launch patent checks.
examplesZh: 我们的送料机构做了个新结构，帮我查下别人有没有先申请过类似专利。
这款设备准备卖到德国，先帮我看看当地有哪些同行专利需要留意。
今年只能报两件发明，把这三份研发交底过一遍，帮我选先申请哪两件。
examplesEn: We've designed a new structure for our feeder. Can you check whether anyone has already filed for something similar?
We're getting ready to sell this equipment in Germany. Can you check which competitors' patents we should look at there?
We can only file two invention applications this year. Look through these three disclosures and help me decide which two to file first.

bundles.descriptionZh: 围绕一个具体政府项目，判断现有条件能不能报、还缺什么，以及后面怎么准备。
bundles.descriptionEn: Assess whether a company can apply for a specific government program, what it is missing, and how to prepare.
examplesZh: 我们在余杭，想报省级企业技术中心。按我发的人员和成果清单，看看今年值不值得准备。
想赶这批市级工业互联网项目，条件和系统运行资料都发你了，帮我看看过哪几条、还卡在哪儿。
这个区里的专项资金项目只剩两周了，按我们现有的合同、人员和交付计划，还来得及把申请做完吗？
examplesEn: We're in Yuhang and want to apply for provincial enterprise technology center recognition. Given our staff and results lists, is it worth preparing this year?
We want to apply in this round of the city industrial internet program. I've sent the requirements and system records. Which conditions do we meet, and where are we stuck?
There are only two weeks left for this district funding program. With our current contracts, staff, and delivery plan, can we still get the application ready in time?

bundles.displayName: 专精特新撰写与培育方案
bundles.descriptionZh: 收费版专精特新与小巨人撰写与培育引擎：含主导产品双字段升维与业态三分支、专利三级分流、六问六答、八段企业简介正文撰写与方向卡成品交付。
bundles.descriptionEn: Draft or review specialized SME and Little Giant applications and find incorrect entries, unclear wording, or missing documents.
examplesZh: 专精特新申请书已经填完了，提交前帮我过一遍，看看哪些地方填错了。
评分表上财务和专利那几项我拿不准，按我填的申报表和附件帮我检查一下。
帮我把专精特新材料里主导产品那一栏补好，产品收入和对应的专利都在附件里。
examplesEn: We've filled out the specialized SME application. Can you review it before we submit and check what we entered incorrectly?
I'm unsure about the finance and patent items on the scoring sheet. Check them against the application and attachments I filled in.
Help me finish the main product section of the specialized SME application. The product revenue and related patents are in the attachments.

bundles.descriptionZh: 按适用标准规则起草或审查技术条款，把技术要求和检验方法对齐。
bundles.descriptionEn: Draft or review technical provisions under the applicable standard rules and align the requirements with the test methods.
examplesZh: 这款气动阀要做企业标准，按我给的技术规格帮我起个草稿。
试验方法已经写好了，帮我看看和前面的技术要求能不能一项一项对上。
团体标准评审收了十几条意见，帮我看看每条意见落实到正文该改哪里。
examplesEn: We need a company standard for this pneumatic valve. Can you draft one from the specifications I sent?
We've written the test methods. Can you check each one against the technical requirements earlier in the document?
We got over ten comments in the association standard review. Can you show me where to edit the draft for each one?

bundles.descriptionZh: 评估企业研发机构、科技项目和奖励的申报条件，梳理任务、预算和验收要求。
bundles.descriptionEn: Assess eligibility for R&D center recognition, science and technology projects, and awards, and organize the tasks, budgets, and acceptance requirements.
examplesZh: 我们想认定省级企业研究院，现有研发人员和设备够不够？
市里的科技计划项目要申报了，帮我排一下这两年做什么、钱怎么花、什么时候验收。
我们想申科技奖励，样机用了两年，现有专利和客户证明够不够支撑这个成果？
examplesEn: We want provincial enterprise research institute recognition. Do we have enough R&D staff and equipment?
We're applying for a city science and technology project. Plan what we'll do over two years, how to spend the budget, and when to run the acceptance review.
We want to apply for a science and technology award. The prototype has been in use for two years. Are the patents and customer letters enough to support our results?
